subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI generated-video downloads treat an inter-chunk gap longer than half the configured request timeout as a failure, or preserve the full configured budget for slow-but-progressing streams while reserving only a narrow margin before the guarded deadline?
rationale: Both choices are viable, but the current half-budget rule deliberately narrows the behavior of existing user-configured timeouts and the repository policy treats removed fallback/stricter timeout behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve the full configured budget
options.body: Use the remaining guarded deadline with a small tested reserve so true stalls receive a download-owned error without broadly halving the tolerated progress interval.

options.title: Adopt the half-budget idle policy
options.body: Accept that slow but progressing xAI CDN responses may fail earlier, and document the new timeout semantics as the intended provider contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the full configured budget
recommendation.body: Use the remaining guarded deadline with a small tested reserve so true stalls receive a download-owned error without broadly halving the tolerated progress interval.

likelyOwner.reason: A maintainer-level product compatibility decision is required; no more specific current-main ownership trail was available from the supplied evidence.
